positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Develop and maintain applications utilizing Java Swing, .NET, Django, PyQt, Python, Java, & C#, Cesium, JavaScript, and React.
•	Utilize git and maven to create efficient build processes for baselines.
•	Develop unit test for software using JUnit, MS Unit Tests, unittest, Cypress, and Jasmine.
•	Work closely with test and configuration management team to continuously deliver our software to the customer in a timely fashion.
•	Collaborate with product owners and users to create reliable and efficient software.
•	Develop software while utilizing Agile methodology.
•	Hold a security clearance.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed and maintained applications utilizing JavaScript, HTML, CSS, XML, & Python.
•	Created Sonar and Fortify scripts to run against baselines to further the knowledge of the repositories code coverage and potential security vulnerabilities.
•	Shadowed and assisted senior software engineers.
•	Develop software while utilizing the Agile methodology.
•	Hold a security clearance.

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description:
•	Currently designing and maintaining SharePoint sites.
•	Assisting in updating the design of the company’s internal and external website. 
•	Replaced retail servers. 
•	Updated company domain certificates.
•	Used UXPin to create a wireframe for an application. 
•	Shadowed and assisted with various job roles including: Application Developers, Database Developers, User Experience Designers, QA Engineers, and Business Analysts.

positions.title: Cashier
positions.description:
•	Assist with hardware and software technical support of all facility systems.
•	Calibrate touch screen devices.
•	Maintain, use and repair computer based point of sale systems.

positions.title: Senior Helpdesk Technician
positions.description:
•	Developed West Monona High School’s Help Desk Program.
•	Imaged Windows and MAC operating systems.
•	Repaired and maintained projectors and printer hardware.
•	Troubleshot and restored systems on both MAC and Windows devices.   
•	Designed graphics for the school’s website and messages for outside digital scroll board.
•	Performed installation of network server hardware. 
•	Retrieved forgotten passwords.
•	Supervised junior help desk technicians.
•	Created iMovies showcasing the West Monona School District to present to state school officials.
•	Trusted to maintain confidentiality.

company.name: West Monona High School Computer Help Desk
